description: Create a NEW Modrinth project (the initial project page). Created as a DRAFT — nothing is public until you submit it for review on the site or set requested_status. This is a write action; only call it when the user explicitly asks to create a new project. After it exists, publish jars with modrinth_create_version.

body.description: Long-form markdown description for the project page.

categories.description: Featured categories, e.g. ['utility','game-mechanics']. Must be valid Modrinth categories for the project_type.

client_side.description: Whether the mod is needed on the client. Editable later.

description.description: Short one-or-two-sentence summary shown in search.

icon_path.description: Absolute path to an icon image (png/jpg/webp/gif/svg).

requested_status.description: Desired status once processed. Stays a draft until you submit for review on the site.

server_side.description: Whether the mod is needed on the server. Editable later.

slug.description: URL slug, 3-64 chars, e.g. 'no-anvil-limit'. Becomes modrinth.com/project/<slug>.

title.description: Project display name, e.g. 'No Anvil Limit'.

name: modrinth_create_project
